## Background

My name is Oliver Reece. I am a current M.S. Finance Student at Fordham University, Gabelli School of Business. 
Prior to pursuing my master's, I graduated from Lawrence University with a B.A. Quantiative Economics and Econometrics, 
with a minor in statistics & data science. 

My two biggest passions are simple: quantitative/analytical challenge and investing smartly. Combining these, 
it makes sense that I am drawn to finance, particularly the banking realm where projection models, risk valuation, 
and profitability are more than present. 

That being said, I am not a robot, and have many interests, especially ones that I am more than happy to talk about
for extended periods of time.
